captions.detailed: A compact, bar-mounted casino slot machine with a dark charcoal cabinet, a single green-tinted screen, and a short control shelf featuring three circular buttons (two orange, one red). A red selector knob is mounted on the right side of the control shelf, a metallic grey coin tray with a hinged flap is located underneath, and a light grey service door is positioned on the rear. The side selector knob is designed to rotate continuously, the bottom coin tray flap rotates on a horizontal hinge, and the rear service panel opens via a vertical side hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact bar-mounted casino machine with a shallow dark cabinet, a green screen, a button shelf with three colored buttons, a side selector knob, a bottom coin tray with a flap, and a rear service panel. The model should include three articulations: a continuous rotation joint for the side selector knob, a revolute joint for the coin tray flap, and a revolute joint for the rear service door.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body, screen bevel, and button shelf using box primitives. Add cylindrical buttons and a side mounting shaft. Create a separate part for the side selector knob using a cylinder and attach it to the cabinet with a continuous joint. Model the coin tray assembly under the cabinet lip, adding a hinged flap part connected via a revolute joint. Finally, construct a flat rear service panel and attach it to the back of the cabinet using a revolute joint with vertical axis limits.
